PMID:37085350.setting: 16 hospitals contributing to the Irish Hip Fracture Database (national audit data)

cycle1.result: Mean time to surgery 40.9 h (SD 60.3 h); longer time to surgery associated with male sex, higher ASA grade, low pre-morbid mobility, inter-hospital transfer, weekday presentation, pre-operative medical assessment, intracapsular fracture, arthroplasty, general anaesthesia, consultant surgeon and lower orthopaedic surgical capacity.

PMID:37085350.other_findings: Regression analysis of factors associated with time to surgery rather than compliance with a standard; none of four explored protocols for expediting surgery were associated with time to surgery.

PMID:38354775.topic: Regional anaesthesia for hip arthroplasty analgesia
PMID:38354775.setting: Complexo Hospitalario Universitario de A Coruña, anaesthesia department

cycle1.result: Peripheral nerve blocks in 169 patients (66.3% femoral, 27.7% PENG, 6.0% fascia iliaca); mean PACU morphine 2.2 mg with PENG and 3.27 mg with femoral block vs 6.69 mg with no block; no difference in opioid rescues at 24 and 48 h.

PMID:38354775.other_findings: Nerve injury incidence 0.8%, not associated with blocks; prolonged quadriceps paralysis 1.3%, mainly after femoral block (75% of cases).

PMID:29082725.setting: Gynecological and Obstetrical University Hospital Sant'Anna, Turin
PMID:29082725.standard: Five literature-derived quality criteria for elective caesarean section, each with a standard; repeat caesarean rate standard ≤30%

cycle1.result: Most indicators met the standard; caesarean rate for previous caesarean was 84% (73/86) against a standard of ≤30%.

PMID:29082725.other_findings: Authors state the audit led to identification of excess repeat caesareans and a significant reduction of them, and further audits are planned; no re-audit figures given.

EPMC:PMC:PMC3032135.topic: Foot health care in systemic sclerosis
EPMC:PMC:PMC3032135.setting: Connective tissue disease outpatient clinic and specialist rheumatology foot health clinic, Chapel Allerton Hospital, Leeds
EPMC:PMC:PMC3032135.standard: UK PRCA/ARMA standards of care: all people with systemic sclerosis should receive at least basic foot health information, and those with foot problems should have access to self-management advice and care

cycle1.result: Only 35/91 (39%) reported receiving foot health information; 49/91 (54%) had previous access to foot care and 38 (42%) were receiving foot care currently; 54 (59%) had current foot problems.

EPMC:PMC:PMC3032135.other_findings: Of 55 patients with foot problems, 32 (58%) had received foot health information and 45 (82%) had previous access to foot care, mostly via the hospital rheumatology foot clinic (29, 53%).

PMID:42030839.setting: UK secondary care centre (Maidstone and Tunbridge Wells Hospital), selective hip ultrasound screening

cycle1.result: DDH (Graf IIb-IV) in 101 macrosomic female infants, prevalence 14.8% (140.3 per 1000; 95% CI 12.3-17.7).

PMID:42030839.other_findings: Of 123 dysplastic hips, 91.1% were managed with a Pavlik harness with a 96.4% success rate; authors suggest adding birthweight ≥4 kg to UK selective screening criteria.

PMID:33068683.setting: 26 public and private healthcare facilities in the Pays de la Loire regional network
PMID:33068683.standard: French national antibiotic prophylaxis guidelines (use, agent, timing within 60 minutes before incision, initial dose, additional doses)

cycle1.result: Overall antibiotic prophylaxis compliance 64%; correct agent 93%; correct initial dose 97.4%; given within 60 minutes before incision in 77.6%.

PMID:33068683.other_findings: Seven procedures audited including total hip arthroplasty; in 26% of appendicectomies prophylaxis was given after incision. An action plan and updated regional protocol were planned.

cycle1.result: 115 TKR and 51 THR patients attended pre-operative education; no difference in hospital costs or length of stay between attenders and non-attenders.

PMID:31612317.other_findings: Total acute stay costs, total costs including travel and education, and comorbidity scores were similar between groups.

PMID:24840657.setting: 10 largest Walk For Life clubfoot clinics

cycle1.result: Two-year outcomes: 99.0% walked independently, 95.5% could run, 93.3% squat, 93.0% manage steps; tenotomy rate 79%; brace use after 2 years 85%.

PMID:24840657.other_findings: Suspected relapse with heel varus (18.0% left, 21.5% right); cost of 3000 Taka was deemed unaffordable by 59% of parents.

PMID:35909372.setting: Multicentre audit in publicly funded health services (FFPOM)
PMID:35909372.standard: British Orthopaedic Association Standard: all surgery in the frail patient should allow full weightbearing for activities required for daily living

cycle1.dates: 1 January 2019 to 30 June 2019, and 1 February 2021 to 14 March 2021
cycle1.result: 16,614 (85.0%) instructed to weightbear for daily living immediately postoperatively: 15,543 (95.7%) hip fracture and 1,071 (32.3%) non-hip fracture patients.

PMID:35909372.other_findings: Median length of stay 12.2 days (IQR 7.9 to 20.0); shaft and distal femur fractures had longer stays than similar hip fracture patients.

EPMC:PMC:PMC4595035.setting: Australasian College of Podiatric Surgeons online audit tool

cycle1.result: 382 foot and ankle surgery cases captured over 3 months using the new tool; data entry valid and reliable, with 100% surgeon audit participation.

EPMC:PMC:PMC4595035.other_findings: Development of an audit tool via case study and Delphi survey; an online survey showed high usability.

PMID:30135041.setting: Review of national hip fracture audits

cycle1.result: not reported

PMID:30135041.other_findings: Narrative review and practical advice on setting up large-scale hip fracture audits.

PMID:26657888.setting: Scottish Hip Fracture Audit and MSK Hip Fracture Audit, participating Scottish hospitals
PMID:26657888.standard: Scottish hip fracture clinical standards including discharge from A&E within 4 h and surgery within 48 h of admission

cycle1.result: Discharge from A&E within 4 h improved from 80.5% (2003) to 96% (2008); surgery within 48 h improved from 89.9% to 98.4%.

PMID:26657888.intervention: Continuous annual audit discontinued in 2008, then re-introduced in 2014

cycle2.result: A&E 4 h improvement not maintained; surgery within 48 h fell to 91.8%.

PMID:26657888.other_findings: 30-day mortality improved and kept improving in 2013; re-introduction of continuous audit in 2014 improved A&E waits and time to theatre again.

cycle1.result: Early complications 47.1% overall; minor 40.5%, major 18.2%.

PMID:20124909.other_findings: Major complications higher in infection (20.0%) and oncologic cases (30.0%) (P=0.07).

PMID:26663418.topic: VTE prophylaxis in lower limb immobilisation
PMID:26663418.standard: Local policy to routinely prescribe aspirin 100 mg daily for Achilles tendon injury requiring lower limb immobilisation

cycle1.result: Aspirin prescribed in 0.5%; symptomatic VTE incidence 6.3%.

PMID:26663418.intervention: Introduction of a policy to routinely prescribe aspirin 100 mg daily

cycle2.result: Aspirin prescribed to 189/218 (93%); symptomatic VTE in 14 (6.4%, 95% CI 3.6-10.5%), unchanged.

PMID:26663418.other_findings: All patients who developed VTE had been prescribed aspirin; authors suggest considering LMWH instead.

PMID:22298064.setting: Members of the Pennsylvania Orthopaedic Society, one audited practice day

cycle1.result: Defensive imaging was 19.1% (396) of orders and 34.7% ($113,675) of total cost; 38.5% (193/501) of MRIs ordered defensively.

PMID:22298064.other_findings: Defensive imaging higher in surgeons sued in previous five years (24.6% vs 15.1%) and those in practice over fifteen years (20.8% vs 17.1%).

PMID:35877041.topic: Tranexamic acid use in hip and knee arthroplasty
PMID:35877041.standard: Evidence-based guidelines and local practice protocols supporting tranexamic acid as standard of care in THA and TKA

cycle1.result: TXA use 66.6% for THA and 62.4% for TKA.

PMID:35877041.intervention: Two individual data reports on TXA use and transfusion compared with peers, plus a group-facilitated feedback session

cycle2.result: TXA use 74.4% for THA (absolute change 7.9%, 95% CI 2.4 to 13.3) and 82.3% for TKA (absolute change 19.9%, 95% CI 15.0 to 25.0).

PMID:35877041.other_findings: Dosing also shifted towards evidence-based practice guidelines.

PMID:31068084.topic: MRSA screening in elective orthopaedic patients
PMID:31068084.setting: Elective orthopaedic waiting list, Royal Gwent Hospital, Newport
PMID:31068084.standard: Trust four-site MRSA screening policy (nose, throat, axilla, groin)

cycle1.result: Positive sites: nose 69.60% (n=96), groin 26.10% (n=36), throat 25.30% (n=35), axilla 8.70% (n=12); a nose, groin and throat three-swab policy would miss 2.2%.

PMID:31068084.intervention: Screening policy changed from four-swab to three-swab (nose, throat, groin)

cycle2.result: Audited four times after the change; all were negative (no figures given).

PMID:31068084.other_findings: Two-swab policies would miss 15.20% to 26.8% of carriers; 11 previously negative sites became positive on repeat swabs, so screening only the previous positive site is not recommended.

EPMC:PMC:PMC3102964.setting: Multi-disciplinary Foot Ulcer Clinic, Royal Perth Hospital

cycle1.result: Complete ulcer healing in 19 (95%) after surgery, mean healing time 61 +/- 44 days, versus mean pre-surgical ulcer duration 468 +/- 410 days; all remained healed at 12 months.

EPMC:PMC:PMC3102964.other_findings: 85% of cases had osteomyelitis; 2 cases superficially re-ulcerated and at least 2 developed transfer lesions.

PMID:31564146.setting: 17 centres in the WHiTE cohort study and National Hip Fracture Database data

cycle1.result: Poor agreement for extracapsular subtypes and moderate for intracapsular subtypes, improving when collapsed; at least 5.2% of NHFD cases had highly improbable procedure and classification combinations.

PMID:31564146.other_findings: Near perfect agreement for internal fixation and substantial or perfect agreement for hemiarthroplasty vs total hip replacement.

cycle1.result: not reported

PMID:23830825.other_findings: Literature review and discussion of clinical audit and re-audit as a feedback loop for spinal surgeons.

PMID:29729949.standard: NOGG 2017 guidelines for patients on long-term glucocorticoids; target 90% investigated and treated appropriately

cycle1.result: Only 25% of patients recommended bisphosphonates were taking them.

PMID:29729949.intervention: GP education on FRAX and NOGG; COPD annual template amended with glucocorticoid course alerts and prompts for alendronate and lifestyle leaflet; 2-monthly RAIDR searches by practice pharmacist
PMID:29729949.other_findings: High and intermediate risk patients above threshold were sent alendronate prescriptions and letters; low-risk patients were sent a lifestyle leaflet.

PMID:32161421.topic: VTE after arthroplasty and hip fracture surgery
PMID:32161421.setting: Waitemata District Health Board, North Shore Hospital

cycle1.result: DVT 2.3% and PE 0.9%, higher than international data at the time.

PMID:32161421.intervention: Multi-modal interdisciplinary approach to VTE prophylaxis using ERAS pathways

cycle2.result: DVT 1.5% and PE 0.6%; 93% received post-operative chemoprophylaxis.

PMID:32161421.other_findings: DVTs were more common after hip fracture surgery than elective arthroplasty, and 71% were distal.

PMID:33414043.setting: 52 UK sites, trainee-led national collaborative audit (AUGMENT)
PMID:33414043.standard: BOAST 12 (BOA/BOFAS) standards for ankle fractures: documentation, imaging, management and follow-up

cycle1.result: Overall BOAST 12 compliance 41.7%; neurovascular documentation 40.7%; VTE assessment 61.5%.

PMID:33414043.other_findings: Compliance with all 16 BOAST 12 standards was associated with higher discharge rate by 12 weeks (p = 0.005).

PMID:41093375.topic: Carbon footprint of shoulder dislocation pathways
PMID:41093375.setting: Emergency department of a major trauma centre in England

cycle1.result: 13 carbon-reduction actions identified, with potential saving of 86.4 kgCO2e per patient.

PMID:41093375.other_findings: Estimated 2666 tonnes CO2e could be saved across England for 2022/2023.

PMID:37777202.setting: 84 UK hospitals, trainee-led national collaborative audit (BOOM)
PMID:37777202.standard: BOOS/BOA guidelines for metastatic bone disease

cycle1.result: No designated MBD lead in 39% of centres (33/84); inadequate radiographs in 19% (160/846); no up-to-date staging CT in 29% (247/846); oncology opinion 69% (584/846); prognosis estimation 38% (223/846).

PMID:37777202.other_findings: Of 215 patients with a solitary metastasis, tertiary MBD centre opinion and biopsy were sought in 60% (130/215); surgery in 38% (319/846).

PMID:32070657.setting: National Medicare data, AAHKS surgeon survey and one academic medical centre

cycle1.result: At the academic centre 470 of 690 (68.1%) Medicare TKA patients left in less than 2 midnights; 66 of 374 (17.65%) survey patients had a QIO audit.

PMID:32070657.other_findings: Health policy and cost analysis of the removal of TKA from the Medicare inpatient-only list.

PMID:18462382.setting: Haemophilia Reference Centre, St Thomas' Hospital, London (home use)

cycle1.result: All patients found the protocol easy to follow and reported pain relief and return to pre-bleed status; 78% reported reduced swelling.

PMID:18462382.other_findings: No adverse effects reported; no conclusive evidence of reduced factor use.

PMID:39875310.setting: Major trauma centres across the four Scottish Trauma Networks (SOFT audit)

cycle1.result: Complete compliance with BOAST guidelines documented in 8.8% of cases.

PMID:39875310.other_findings: Infection 24%, return to theatre 17%, soft-tissue failure 9.7%, amputation 7.1%; improvement needed in antibiotic timing, combined ortho-plastics approach and soft-tissue cover within 72 h.

cycle1.result: Only three of nine ACS audit filters identified significantly worse outcomes (including femur fracture without fixation).

PMID:7932886.other_findings: Several ACS indicators were associated with better outcomes than their comparison groups; authors call for data-driven audit filters.

PMID:27427564.setting: Four large primary care clinics in Edmonton, Alberta

cycle1.result: 110 met the a priori threshold for MRI, CT or bone scan; none of the remaining 893 showed a non-benign cause of spinal pain at 1 year or more.

PMID:27427564.other_findings: New diagnoses in imaged patients included radiculopathy (n = 12, one cauda equina syndrome), spondyloarthropathy (n = 6) and occult fracture (n = 2).

PMID:15467495.setting: Two orthopaedic operating rooms, S. Maria del Prato Hospital, Feltre, without a post-anaesthetic care unit
PMID:15467495.standard: Defined discharge criteria: modified Aldrete score ≥7, systolic BP within 20% of pre-operative value, no nausea/vomiting or shivering, pain absent or mild

cycle1.result: Discharge criteria observed in 74%; not fully met in 26% (69/261): 14 unstable vital signs, 46 uncontrolled pain, 6 nausea/vomiting, 3 shivering.

PMID:15467495.other_findings: Complication incidence 2.6%; mean post-anaesthetic care time 40 +/- 18 minutes (median 35 minutes).

PMID:25146093.topic: MRI for suspected occult hip fracture
PMID:25146093.setting: Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust, radiology department (inpatients)
PMID:25146093.standard: NICE hip fracture guidance (June 2011): MRI within 24 hours for suspected occult femoral neck fracture

cycle1.result: Mean wait for MRI 2,025.4 min (SD 2,406.4).

PMID:25146093.intervention: Strategies addressing correctable delays: clinicians not contacting duty radiologist directly, slow vetting and protocoling of electronic requests, resistance to weekend scanning, and delay in MRI safety questionnaire completion; results presented at directorate audit meetings

cycle2.result: 16% improvement in patients scanned within 24 h; mean wait 1,374 min (SD 1,635.7); mean difference 651.4 min (95% CI 85.21, 1,217.5; p = 0.0243).

PMID:19686612.setting: 223 UK hospitals, NHS Blood and Transplant national comparative audit
PMID:19686612.standard: National comparative audit indicators and standards for transfusion practice

cycle1.result: 47% of hospitals had a transfusion policy; 73% did group-and-save rather than cross-match; of patients transfused, 7% had a single unit and 67% two units; 65% of those given two or more units had post-transfusion Hb 10 g/dl or more.

PMID:19686612.other_findings: 15% had pre-operative Hb below 12 g/dl, and 57% of these were transfused compared with 20% with higher values; wide variation in transfusion rates between hospitals.

EPMC:PPR:PPR27821.topic: Genetics of developmental dysplasia of the hip
EPMC:PPR:PPR27821.setting: English National Joint Registry case ascertainment

cycle1.result: GWAS of 770 DDH cases and 3364 controls; GDF5 promoter variant rs143384 associated with DDH (OR 1.44, 95% CI 1.34-1.56).

EPMC:PPR:PPR27821.other_findings: Genetic association study using national audit data for recruitment; heritability from common variants 55%.

PMID:22526038.topic: Trauma quality improvement in low and middle income countries
PMID:22526038.setting: Expert meeting at Royal Australasian College of Surgeons, Melbourne, and pre-meeting survey

cycle1.result: Reported trauma QI activities: morbidity and mortality conferences (56%), monitoring complications (31%), preventable death studies (25%), audit filters (19%).

PMID:22526038.other_findings: Mixed methods study; gaps included poor injury data, absent standards of care and lack of QI training.

PMID:24239938.setting: Emergency orthopaedic trauma inpatients, Royal London Hospital
PMID:24239938.standard: Royal College of Surgeons of England guidelines on operation notes

cycle1.result: Time of surgery and patient age 0%; closure details 60%; antibiotics at induction 69%; legible handwriting 66%.

PMID:24239938.intervention: Electronic operation note proforma with drop-down selections

cycle2.result: Time of surgery and age 75%; closure details and antibiotics at induction 100%; post-operative instructions 100%; legibility 100%.

PMID:24239938.other_findings: All notes contained an operation note after the change (previously 5/6).

PMID:36507694.topic: Physiotherapy care guideline after knee arthroplasty
PMID:36507694.setting: Intermountain Healthcare rehabilitation services, outpatient physical therapy
PMID:36507694.standard: Achievement of minimal clinically important difference on KOS-ADL following TKA

cycle1.result: 25.8% of patients did not progress on the KOS-ADL.

PMID:36507694.intervention: Physical therapy care guideline introduced in 2013, with outcome data access, audit feedback, performance goals and financial incentives

cycle2.result: 14.3% of patients did not progress on the KOS-ADL.

PMID:36507694.other_findings: 12,355 patients in total; improvement achieved without an increase in clinical visits.

PMID:22760390.setting: Orthopaedic ward, University of Washington Medical Center

cycle1.result: Falls with injury 1.17 and total falls 4.24 per 1000 patient days (11,082 patient days).

PMID:22760390.intervention: Four systems-based fall-prevention interventions targeting high-risk situations

cycle2.result: Falls with injury 0.41 (p = 0.036) and total falls 2.53 (p = 0.024) per 1000 patient days (12,267 patient days).

PMID:22760390.other_findings: Falls were reviewed in real time via a shared clinical database; authors consider it unrealistic that all falls are preventable.

PMID:23173019.topic: Discharge summary content after joint replacement
PMID:23173019.setting: General practitioners in a defined catchment area, Western Australia (online instrument)

cycle1.result: 53 GPs and 9 GP registrars responded (11.0% response rate); components rated essential by 14.8-88.5%.

PMID:23173019.other_findings: Essential items were early GP actions, medications, complications and allergies; prosthesis details were non-essential.

cycle1.result: Around 70% of hip fracture patients in Western and Northern region hospitals had definitive stabilisation more than 48 hours after admission.

PMID:41376470.other_findings: Hip fracture was the most common fracture (22.2%); variation between hospitals in delays, time to surgery and antibiotic use.
